g.title: hooks
g.text: Hook retrieval and delivery ownership | refactor candidate

g.title: tool
g.text: Codex: current job; legacy worker entry retained

g.title: stop
g.text: recursion guard; structural signals if not Jev

g.title: legacy
g.text: open DB -> structural retrieval -> OS filter
markHit OR opt-in miss log -> close DB

g.title: jev
g.text: observation saved as pending / suppressed / none

g.title: leak
g.text: search/filter/diagnostic failure or early return closes DB
close/diagnostic throw reaches existing host error handler

g.title: jevskip
g.text: tool and stop suppress legacy search
